# Assessment Overview

Supplementary analysis for the Photo Album application:

- [Architecture diagram](architecture-diagram.md) — Application topology, technology stack, components, and their relationships.
- [Dependency map](dependency-map.md) — Declared libraries, version management, build tooling, and compatibility considerations.
- [API and service contracts](api-service-contracts.md) — HTTP endpoints, request and response contracts, security behavior, and communication sequences.
- [Data architecture](data-architecture.md) — Entity model, Oracle persistence, repository operations, and data lifecycle risks.
- [Configuration inventory](configuration-inventory.md) — Application profiles, environment variables, deployment settings, and configuration risks.
- [Business workflows](business-workflows.md) — Photo upload, gallery navigation, deletion, and associated business rules.

These documents describe the inspected source; they do not establish runtime or deployment verification. Review generated analysis before making modernization decisions.
